title: Localized scalar tensor representative squares respect towers
statement: For finite coefficient fields E,L,F over Q_l, coefficient maps iota:E→L and j:L→F, and good integral cochain representatives, the Q-localized tensor chain square intertwines the coefficient tower associator. Explicitly, scalar transport of the first exact scalar factor and chain comparison, followed by the second factor, second chain comparison and the operation applied to the input scalar associator, equals the output derived scalar associator followed by the direct exact scalar factor and chain comparison. The underlying chain comparison is [lem-pur-integral-scalar-tensor-chain-tower], and the scalar associators are [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition].

source.place: Tensor reassociation, evaluation and coefficient comparisons; scalar-comparison proof step 9 of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08J9 and 08TC.

proof.text: Naturality of the second exact scalar factor moves the first chain comparison past that factor. Combine the remaining Q-images by functoriality and use the chain tower equation. The exact-derived scalar composition factors formula identifies the two successive factors with the output derived scalar associator followed by the direct factor. This proves the explicit component equation; the private component families record its normalized square version for faithful descent.

theorem integralScalarTensorTowerOnRepresentatives
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra ℚ_[l] F] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
    (j : L →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F) (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory ×
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l L F j W).map
      ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).obj (P.1.obj, P.2.obj)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarTensorChain l E L ι W P.1.obj P.2.obj)) ≫
      (integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l L W).obj
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.1.obj,
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.2.obj)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarTensorChain l L F j W
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.1.obj)
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.2.obj)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l F W).map
        (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app P.1.obj)
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app P.2.obj))) =
    (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalarComp l E L ι W F j).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).obj (P.1.obj, P.2.obj))) ≫
      (integralOrdinaryScalar l E F (j.comp ι) W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).obj (P.1.obj, P.2.obj)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarTensorChain l E F (j.comp ι) W P.1.obj P.2.obj)
